title: Butternut, Red Lentil & Ginger Soup with Shredded Chicken
description: A thick, warming squash and lentil soup with cumin, smoked paprika and ginger, with chicken breast poached in the pot and shredded back in.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion with a pinch of salt and cook 6 min until soft and translucent.

steps.title: Toast the spices
steps.text: Stir in the ginger, cumin and smoked paprika and cook for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer squash and lentils
steps.text: Add the squash, lentils, stock and remaining salt. Bring to the boil, then lower to a steady simmer for 10 min, stirring now and then so the lentils don't catch.

steps.title: Poach the chicken in the soup
steps.text: Submerge the chicken breasts whole in the simmering soup, cover and cook 18 min, until the chicken reaches 74 °C in the thickest part and the squash is completely soft.

steps.title: Toast the seeds
steps.text: While the chicken poaches, dry-toast the pumpkin seeds in a small pan over medium heat for 3–4 min until they puff and pop. Toast the sourdough too.

steps.title: Shred and blend
steps.text: Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks. Blend the soup smooth with a stick blender, adding a splash of water if it's too thick. Stir in the lemon juice and shredded chicken, and taste for salt.

steps.title: Serve and split
steps.text: Matthias: about two-thirds of the pot (two generous bowls), 15 g of the pumpkin seeds and the toast. Partner: the remaining third with 10 g seeds.

notes: No protein bridge needed: lentils and chicken cover it. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
